repositories.architectureType: Multi-protocol Actor-driven broker featuring non-blocking Netty I/O channels, MPSC lock-free queue ingest with PriorityLinkedList delivery, Direct AIO / libaio aligned circular append-only journal persistence, cursor-indexed multi-page file overflow paging, term-based distributed lock coordinator failover, and dual-quorum network replication.
Redis-backed Client-Server task queue with distributed lease expiration, periodic heartbeater renewals, centralized sweep recoverer, and PubSub out-of-band cancellation.

Clustered Multi-Tier Broker-Proxy architecture featuring single-threaded-per-queue event dispatching (bmqc::MultiQueueThreadPool), quorum-replicated append-only journal/data file storage (mqbs::FileStore), term-and-lease-scoped leader election (mqbc::Elector), two-stage cluster state ledger consensus (mqbc::ClusterStateLedger), and custom binary wire protocol (bmqp::Event).
Redis-backed client-worker queue with token-fenced leasing, Lua-mediated atomic state transitions, mark-and-sweep stall detection, and child process isolation

Single-table SQLite queue with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), integer token-fenced message delivery claims, connection-pooled query-only read isolation, BEFORE INSERT trigger capacity constraints, and atomic SQL state transitions.

In-Memory Sublist Radix-Trie Router with Zero-Allocation Protocol Parser, Dynamic Client Buffer Write-Vectoring, HighwayHash Block-Indexed File Store (WAL), and Custom Log-Replicated Raft Consensus Engine (NRG).

PostgreSQL relational table-backed message queue with MVCC row leasing via SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, visibility timeout expiration, transactional topic-based routing, pg_partman partition management, and trigger-driven throttled NOTIFY publication.

C++ Seastar-based thread-per-core shared-nothing actor architecture with shard-local Raft consensus groups, direct I/O (O_DIRECT) DMA log segment storage, transactional state machine fencing (rm_stm), and tiered cloud storage shadow indexing.

PostgreSQL-backed ACID-compliant job queue leveraging FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED row-level locking, LISTEN/NOTIFY real-time push dispatch, partial unique indexes for deduplication, term-scoped leader election on unlogged tables, and asynchronous batch completion.

Decoupled Distributed Multi-Tier Broker architecture with stateless NameServer route coordination, unified physical CommitLog append-only storage with concurrent logical ConsumeQueue dispatching, two-tier off-heap TransientStorePool memory pinning (mlock), synchronous/asynchronous disk flush pipelines, epoch-scoped SyncStateSet replication (AutoSwitchHAService / DLedger Controller), and server-side Pop/Push consumption state machines.
